reviews.author: Emmanual Harrison
reviews.text: Me and my wife both have dealed with Mr. Dan many times when we needed our vehicles towed. And I must truly say he will get back to you at promptly time. Always been respectful and straight up no cutting coners whatsoever. Very dedicated to servicing Brunswick County to him it's more than the money he enjoys building a relationship and he does have wisdom when it comes to vehicles that aren't operating as in telling you what it could be or what not. I extremely recommend him for your towing specialist

reviews.author: Jamie Morrell
reviews.text: Dan was absolutely amazing! He was to me within 10mins of me calling him. He got me towed to a reliable mechanic at a reasonable price. Will definitely be using his services again!!!

reviews.author: Skyler Glasner
reviews.text: He was there in 20 minutes. Super quick and was respectful even after I changed my towing location last minute.

reviews.author: Zachary Harden
reviews.text: I just want to give a huge thank you to Discount Towing for helping me out of a tough situation. My truck got stuck deep in the mud, and I wasn’t sure how I was going to get it out. I called Discount Towing, and they were incredibly responsive, professional, and fast. The driver arrived quicker than expected, was super friendly, and knew exactly what to do. They had my truck out in no time without any damage, and the price was very fair, especially considering how stressful the situation was. It's clear they know what they’re doing, and they genuinely care about helping people. I’m extremely grateful for their help and wouldn’t hesitate to call them again or recommend them to anyone in need of a tow.

reviews.author: Orin Bookout
reviews.text: He was great he was there within the hour and we where able to get my car home safe great guy definitely recommend. And he dint charge an arm and a leg

reviews.author: Jordan Clark
reviews.text: We called AAA for a tow, and they couldn’t find anyone. I called Shallotte towing myself and he was amazing. He came to where we were within 20 minutes. Took great care to make sure our needs were met and got us where we needed to go. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: T Barry
reviews.text: Dan was awesome. He showed up quickly. Like in 15 minutes! And had a fair price. Best local tow in shallote! Great guy. Thanks Dan!

reviews.author: Dawn Suggs
reviews.text: I Called Early Morning To Get A Truck And Camper Pulled Out Of A Deep Sandy Situation!!! Danny Came Out And Got Us Out In No Time !!! Hes Very Knowledgeable And Caring … And Very Reasonable… I Definitely Recommend Him

reviews.author: Savannah Beckner
reviews.text: Best towing company I’ve dealt with ever! He was very nice, professional, and patient! He got here very fast! Didn’t wait long at all! He explained everything before he did anything! His price is also amazing! Definitely recommend him! He’s the best!

reviews.author: John Iacovone
reviews.text: Danny is Awesome! I was out of town for work and my friend needed a tow, I called Danny. He gave me a price on the phone, showed up promptly when he said he would and even went so far as messaging me directly when the job was completed! I'd give him 10 stars if I could. thank you for being a stand up guy Danny!

reviews.author: Timmy Burkett
reviews.text: Dan was very easy to deal with and helped me and one of my drivers out in a time of need. Was honest and reliable and didn't charge us what others would have for the same service. He understands that things happen and don't try to get rich off someone else's mis fortune!

reviews.author: Skip Mangum
reviews.text: Called Dan to help tow my disabled vehicle to a local mechanic. Dan answered on the second ring, was at my location within 30 mins, was very friendly and personable, gave great advice and had me taken care of at a fair and reasonable price. I was very satisfied and would recommend him to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: Mazie hurlbut
reviews.text: Dan was amazing. We had a real specialized move that we needed to arrange from a far. Dan ensured us he could handle that job and he did excellent!! Would definitely call on Dan in the future. Very thorough and always answers his phone. You took the stress out of this move, thank you Dan!

reviews.author: Gabby Parks
reviews.text: If I ever need another tow, this is the only company I’ll be calling! You cannot beat the price and the owner is very kind. Thank you for making my stressful day so much easier!

reviews.author: Sandy Lockey
reviews.text: Called Dan tonight! We were stuck at an intersection when my husbands clutch went out in his jeep. Dan was quick to respond and had us home in no time! Thanks so much Dan! We will definitely use you in the future if we ever need a tow again!

reviews.author: David snead
reviews.text: Fantastic indeed!! Towed my jeep and my trailer that was hooked up to my broken down jeep. No problem he said, no extra charge. Price was great! He even took my trailer and wife home first so it was easier for us! Definitely call them first!!!

reviews.author: Sean Swain
reviews.text: Awesome company. They have been around a long time and it shows. it was easy , fast, and very professional but gave you the home town feel. Good People deserve good reviews. Thanks for everything from Markraft Cabinets.

reviews.author: John Schmidt
reviews.text: Dan answered and came right out to get us after we hit an animal 30 minutes from town. He helped talk us through the process with insurance claims and rental cars and absolutely saved the day. Even dropped us off at our beach house, excellent service!

reviews.author: **Marie Meshaw**
reviews.text: I told Danny my car was broken down and be went out of his way to help me. If it had not been for him, I may have been forced to use some overly priced company. He picked up my car on Superbowl Sunday and brought it to my home. He put my needs first and took very good care of my vehicle. I would not let anyone else handle my car when it comes to towing. He is extremely quick and reliable. I would suggest him to anyone needing assistance!

reviews.author: Daniel Ward
reviews.text: Dan came through again! He shows up when he schedules and he is easy to deal with. He helped us get out of a remote location after a multiple faulty tire issue in the past and I was glad he was available again when we needed him to transport our vehicle to the garage.

reviews.author: Angela Harper
reviews.text: Dan is the nicest man! I was STUCK and filled with anxiety. I had driven from Greensboro to Holden Beach and my car overheated. I had it "worked on" at a local place and they didn't fix it and ended up having it towed to BMW Wilmington. Dan took great care of me and was kind and reassuring the entire time. I highly recommend him!!!

reviews.author: Tara Marie
reviews.text: I had to have my car towed today after getting not 1 but 2 flat tires - (probably from all the construction on 17) called Dan at Discount Towing and he was able to get to me quickly. He was very professional and helpful with reasonable rates. I highly recommend this company! Thank you Dan!

reviews.author: Hannah Caudill
reviews.text: Dan was recommended to tow my car by a friend, and really exceeded my expectations. He was very professional and super friendly! Would definitely recommend him for any towing needs and will call him again for any future issues.

reviews.author: sebrena norton
reviews.text: The most amazing service ever! After waiting 2 1/2 hours for AAA they called me back and suggested I give this company a call as they were unable to get to me. Here it is almost dark and I speak to Dan owner of Shallotte discount towing. He arrives about 15 mins after my not so good directions of my whereabouts. I highly recommend this company superb services

reviews.author: Derrick Cannon
reviews.text: Great towing company! Called him after 5:30 on a Friday evening, and Dan was happy to oblige. Great guy, awesome to work with, really knew his stuff. Dan is the only wrecker driver I’ll call from now on.

reviews.author: Matt Clark
reviews.text: Called Dan at 10am about towing out a truck stuck in my yard with a boat attached. By 12noon he had me pulled out with minimal effort, and he avoided putting ruts in my yard. Fantastic experience and will definitely use again if needed.

reviews.author: Steve Yost
reviews.text: Dan showed up quickly and was super friendly and was able to recommend good service in an area that we were totally unfamiliar with. Highly recommend this company if the unexpected happens to you in the surrounding area.

reviews.author: Angie Brakefield
reviews.text: An excellent company! Helped my mother and I move our truck, at the last minute, on a Sunday morning. Rates were more than fair and the conversation afterwards was priceless! I could never express how wonderful they were. Thank You so much Dan!

reviews.author: Fred Caulder
reviews.text: Need my van hauled to the shop. Dan was here in under 30minutes. Best rate in town I won't be calling any other company. I found my diamond, this is the 2nd time I have used him and won't be the last. First car he hauled was a Ford flex(7passenger) and this time was a dodge Grand caravan handicapped equiped. So believe in Dan he is the man for all your hauling needs.

reviews.author: Shakema Morgan
reviews.text: My experience with Discount Towing was amazing. Dan was very professional and arrived earlier than the expected time to tow my car. If you ever need a dependable company to take care of any towing needs, Discount Tire is definitely the business to contact.

reviews.author: Sherri Graham
reviews.text: Fast, friendly and very humble experience with Mr. Dan. He was very kind and gave great advice. Thank you

reviews.author: Jill Johnson
reviews.text: I waited 3hrs for AAA to arrive while I was on the side of the road with a flat. I finally gave up and called Shallotte Discount Towing. He arrived from 25 min away in 32 minutes!! He was so nice and cheaper than 2yrs ago when I had to have a tow with another company. I'll call him for sure if I ever need another tow truck.

reviews.author: David B. Fowler (MadHatter)
reviews.text: Great service! Fast , reliable and great rates. I have used this tow co. quite a few times. Professional service. Mr.Dan is very polite, professional and quick to respond. Will definitely be using his services from now on.

reviews.author: Jestinee Brown
reviews.text: Very nice and kind and willing to help in any way possible to make things go as smooth as they could, when life threw me a wrench the owner definitely did his part to help me twist it! Very well priced as well specially during the hectic holidays. Thank you very much Dan!!

reviews.author: Tim Jennings
reviews.text: Really helped me out in a pinch. Dan was great. He came really quick and was even able to work with my budget. I really appreciate discount towing..

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: Dan is an amazing businessman and just a good man. I am out of state and he helped me out a lot!!! Hopefully I do not need another tow soon but if I do Dan is the one!!!

reviews.author: Burt Weiner
reviews.text: Had Dan pick an Austin Healey to be delivered to a long distance hauler. He exceeded my expectations by showing up early, taking great care loading and transporting the car. He is experienced and a real gentleman. You cannot go wrong with Shallotte Discount Towing!

reviews.author: Jodi Chester
reviews.text: Very nice man! Came right out and took care of my car. Once he delivered the car to the shop he text me to let me know all was okay! Reasonable price especially for after hours on a Friday.

reviews.author: Brian Krass
reviews.text: Dan is excellent. Was timely and very careful loading my Escalade. Towed the vehicle from oak island to Wilmington with no issues. Even gave us a ride to house. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Kimberly Foods
reviews.text: I was broke down on side of road and I called he was there as fast as he could . I was 40 minutes away.Loaded up my car with my two dogs in it and let me and my son ride up front with him. Was super nice and the price was very reasonable! I would definitely call this company again!

reviews.author: Elise Whaley
reviews.text: Gave us great advice on what to do with our car and went the extra mile to help us. Hard to find someone that helpful and nice, and willing to take time out of his work day to council us. Will definitely be using him again!

reviews.author: John Mansfield
reviews.text: Dan with discount towing was awesome. Very well mannered and old school, treats people how he would like to be treated. I would recommend Discount Towing 100% everytime. He has my business!

reviews.author: tamara thompson
reviews.text: Dan is the best!!! He moved my expedition on such short notice!!! Was told it would take 2 trucks from another company this guy came in woth 1 truck and was VERY reasonable!!! Will use hom again!! Such a great guy!!!

reviews.author: Nathan Cumbee
reviews.text: Dan was fantastic, I thought the price was fair and am very happy with the service and this company!

reviews.author: Lee Johnson
reviews.text: Excellent all the way around, gladly recommend this company to everyone.,excellent customer service. Great people , honest hard working and a pleasure to do business with. They are not out to make a killing only a living. They do business the old fashion way and it shows. My hats off to all at Shallotte discount towing!

reviews.author: Tammy Taylor
reviews.text: Mr. Here was AMAZING! Fast professional friendly service at a reasonable price even on a Sunday. I would recommend him to anyone. If I ever need a tow in the future I know who I’ll call.

reviews.author: Angela Cribb
reviews.text: I called at 8 am to have my son's jeep towed to a mechanic and he was here withing the hour to help out. Very nice and professional. Thank you for making part of the process of getting his car back on the road less stressful!

reviews.author: Sophie Wolfe
reviews.text: Dan was an absolute dream to work with! I called at 6 in the morning and he answered the phone almost right as it rang. He was where I needed him within 30 minutes and helped me get my car to where I needed to go! I can't thank him enough! I can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Patrick Herndon
reviews.text: Danny is a great guy and assisted with loading a hot shot driver with a pick up truck that had dead batteries. He was super professional and very quick. I would highly recommend calling him for anything.

reviews.author: Phillip Mcculloch
reviews.text: Dan was top notch. Got to me in less than thirty minutes and was very reasonable on his rate. He was also very friendly. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Selena E
reviews.text: Dan is great. Car was on the side of the road. He picked it up promptly and brought it to my house. Very friendly and affordable.

reviews.author: Katherine Knibbs
reviews.text: My insurance company couldn't find me a tow truck after over an hour of waiting. I called Shallotte Discount and he was there within a half hour. Great service!

reviews.author: Dean Nelson
reviews.text: Dan was excellent.He showed up on Saturday morning to unload two monster toolbox’s from a tractor trailer with his flatbed. Very professional job. I Recommend him all day everyday.

reviews.author: Amber G
reviews.text: Dan was great! Arrived promptly on a holiday evening. I would have been waiting hours for AAA. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anthony Smith
reviews.text: Shallotte Discount Towing is amazing. They are quick to respond with good equipment and Dan the owner knows what to do. Very respectfully with great prices. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Brandon Padilla
reviews.text: I was stranded in a bad spot. I found Shallotte Discount Towing. Dan was super responsive and made my situation a priority. To top off the great service his prices were the best in town. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: timothy fisher
reviews.text: Was very helpful. Got to the site on a fast and very short wait. And worked a good price for how far the tow was. Would recommend and day if your in need of a tow

reviews.author: Hannah G
reviews.text: Dan was very friendly and able to get to us in less than 15 minutes. Extremely knowledgeable, affordable and professional! We are so grateful

reviews.author: Amanda Alsbrooks
reviews.text: Guy was friendly and arrived quick. However, I had a hard time trying to get an invoice from him for my insurance company. He did work with me tho.

reviews.author: kade ledoux
reviews.text: I must say this is a extremely good towing company I broke down in shallotte Walmart parking lot on a Sunday morning and called. He came as fast as he could and was extremely nice even with my son all in his way being a 9 year old boy watching because he thought it was “cool” he was nice about it and even explained to my son what he was doing very professional of him. I wouldn’t want to use any other towing company around.

reviews.author: TRACY STANCILL
reviews.text: Mr. Kerr came and helped us out when we popped a tire and didn't have a spare. He was kind enough to take us to the closest gas station to see if we just need to put air in the tire. When we found the hole in it, he then towed us to the local Walmart to drop off my car and then was kind enough to take us back to the place we were staying so we didn't have to call a cab (we were on vacation). I hope something like this never happens again, but if it did, I know who I'd call.

reviews.author: Jennifer Lee
reviews.text: It was such pleasure having Mr. Dan come to the rescue, getting stuck somewhere and not knowing what to do. He is kind, efficient, and the best all around!! Don’t hesitate to call y’all!

reviews.author: lori bailey
reviews.text: The man was there in 10 minutes! He helped me above and beyond! He gave me numbers of local folk who could fix my car for a lot cheaper to. A LOT cheaper.

reviews.author: Eric Bryant
reviews.text: Dan is the man!! I broke down on 17 last week and couldn't get any tow service to return my calls. So I came across Discount Towing and within 10 minutes Dan pulled up and helped me out! Thanks Dan at Shallotte Discount Towing!!

reviews.author: Brian Evans
reviews.text: Discount towing helped me when I was in bad need of help . All of the bridges were flooded and could not get to my house to check on things. I live 200 miles away from supply. I called discount towing to check on my place and he did me a big favor at no charge during the hurricane. Thanks discount towing I will use you from now own.

reviews.author: Sherry Martin
reviews.text: Thanks so much to Dan...he really cares about his customers... he's reliable, helpful, honest and affordable. I will recommend Discount Towing to family and friends.

reviews.author: Jim Eckart
reviews.text: The truck broke down and we called him for service... he was amazing!! - so polite and even helped us with an automobile repair shop that was highly recommended!!! --- highly recommend this company!!!!

reviews.author: Laurie Hill
reviews.text: Dan was quick to respond to our call and and there to tow our vehicle within 30 minutes (in the rain). Great service!

reviews.author: Henrik DK
reviews.text: Had to have my car moved to a different dealership. Dan was very helpful and accommodating, and made it very easy. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: James Hoffmier
reviews.text: Quick service! Went out of his way to assist. Very nice individual that really helped me out in a pinch. Can’t thank him enough.

reviews.author: W christman
reviews.text: Very responsive and professional. Best price I found in the area and was helpful enough to stop at the parts store on the way to my home. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Weston Bellamy
reviews.text: This company was the cheapest and the faster tow compared to the other companies. He was 150 cheaper and was at my house in 40 minutes. Thank u

reviews.author: Laura Hargrove
reviews.text: Within minutes the owner was able to arrive to assist me. He went above and beyond just towing me car. Highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Dennis Faver
reviews.text: This the second time I've called on Dan to move my baby and he always treats it like his own car. That's what you look for when you need to move a classic.

reviews.author: Marcus Poff
reviews.text: Great price! Great service! Very professional. Arrived right when he said he would and brought me straight to correct destination.

reviews.author: Stellah Bellai
reviews.text: This company is not right. 325.00 to pull my van out of mud. He got wet and muddy. Drove over 20 miles. No one else would do tow he said. So he robbed me.

reviews.author: Taylor LaChance
reviews.text: Shallotte discount towing went above and beyond when I was in need of a tow service. They were super fast and provided great customer care. Highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Richard bowser
reviews.text: This is the only tow service I'll ever Use again Dan was quick to get there very nice and just all around great guy.

reviews.author: john mccracken
reviews.text: After AAA left me sitting for 4 hours, called Dan and he was there in 30 minutes. Thanks for your service.

reviews.author: Kyle Boom
reviews.text: This service was to my car in 10 minutes when triple A said they would take 6 hours. He was cheaper than triple A and we even have a discount.

reviews.author: Natasha Harrison
reviews.text: I broke down outside Wilmington, Called mr Dan towing he was there within 20 mins... made sure i was safe and all!!!..Amazing Service!!!

reviews.author: Mitchell Cartee
reviews.text: my truck broke on hwy 130 called discount towing mr. kerr was very polite and hie service was great would recommend discount towing to anyone

reviews.author: Brigid Colthurst
reviews.text: This company arrived quick, was very professional and friendly. The prices are very reasonable and I would recommend to anyone hands down.

reviews.author: sam delio
reviews.text: The owner was extremely polite and helpful and responded quickly. The first time ever I didn't mind breaking down lol

reviews.author: Erica Long
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about Shallotte Discount towing. Very professional. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jeff Elcess
reviews.text: After waiting on AAA for five hours called Dan and he was there in twenty minutes. Very professional. Saved the day

reviews.author: Przemyslaw Matuszewski
reviews.text: Best experience I ever had. On timebest pro experience and went out of the way to help me in my need. And best price
